title: Peek A Boo Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Idealistic Old Florida-style design principles blend with the comforts of the English countryside with the emergence of the appropriately named, ‘English Cottage’.
description_expanded: Description70 ROBERT'S WAY1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 BUNK WITH TWO FULL BEDS (sleeps 6 Total)PET FRIENDLY UP TO 10 LBS.Charming Coastal Retreat on Robert’s Way in Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Peek-A-Boo, a beautifully renovated beach cottage perfectly positioned on iconic Robert’s Way—just two homes from the sugar-white sands of Seaside, Florida. Surrounded by lush greenery and classic coastal architecture, this inviting hideaway captures the essence of relaxed beach living while offering one of the most desirable locations in town. With the gentle sound of waves nearby and Seaside’s signature charm at every turn, Peek-A-Boo makes it easy to settle in and feel like a local from the moment you arrive.Outdoor Living Overlooking Rosewalk ParkOne of Peek-A-Boo’s most special features is its rear open-air porch overlooking Rosewalk Park, a hidden green space cherished by families. Shaded by mature climbing trees, this peaceful park provides a scenic area for children to play while adults unwind nearby. The porch is thoughtfully furnished with outdoor dining for four and two Adirondack chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee, relaxed lunches, or sunset cocktails in the evening breeze.Renovated Kitchen & Inviting Living SpaceInside, the home features a fully renovated kitchen designed with both function and style in mind. Custom cabinetry, a four-burner electric stove, mounted microwave, full-size refrigerator, and essential cookware make preparing meals simple and convenient after a day at the beach. The kitchen opens directly into the dining and living area, where a custom-built banquette seats five to six—perfect for shared meals or game nights.The living room offers a comfortable place to unwind, with a sofa, two club chairs, and a mounted flat-screen TV—ideal for relaxing after long beach days.Comfortable Sleeping Quarters for FamiliesPeek-A-Boo offers a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for couples and families. On the main level, the first bedroom features a queen bed with built-in shelving, a hanging closet, mounted reading lights, and a ceiling fan for added comfort. The second bedroom includes a double-over-double bunk bed and a small closet for convenient storage. These rooms share a fully renovated bathroom with a single vanity and a tub/shower combination.Upstairs, a private loft retreat provides additional separation and comfort, featuring a king bed dressed in crisp white linens and a convenient half bath. A Juliette balcony completes the loft, offering a peaceful spot to enjoy Gulf breezes and the distant sound of the waves.Unbeatable Location Near Beach & Town CenterPeek-A-Boo is located just 417 feet (a two-minute walk) from the private residential beach access at Tupelo Pavilion, one of the most desirable stretches of beach in Seaside. Central Square, the Seaside Amphitheater, and more than 35 shops and restaurants are all within a five-minute walk, placing the best of Seaside right at your doorstep.Additional Amenities for a Relaxed StayGuests will enjoy thoughtful extras that enhance every stay, including a full-size stackable washer and dryer, an enclosed outdoor shower with hot water for rinsing off after beach days, and a charcoal grill for easy outdoor meals.Whether you’re planning a family beach vacation or a relaxed coastal escape, Peek-A-Boo offers comfort, charm, and an exceptional location—making it a Seaside retreat you’ll want to return to year after year.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $50 a day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $125 pet fee for a two-bedroom home. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No pet over 10 lbs. One dog only.FEATURESFeatures: 740 square feet (900 square feet including covered porches)Beach Access: 2-minute walk, 417 feet to beach accessPrivate Beach: Private residential Seaside beach at Tupelo Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30APet Friendly: Pets allowed up to 10 lbsOutdoor Shower: Enclosed outdoor showerGrill: Charcoal grillLaundry: Washer & dryerLinens: Peacock Alley linens with fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAmenities Access: Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityService: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Carts: Two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitSTR23-002212
